bullets: Own and continuously improve the first-use product journey, from the user's first interaction through clinical handoff, increasing conversion rates for all DTC and partner funnels.
Collaborate with Marketing on acquisition landing pages and the transition into the product experience, ensuring acquisition strategy and first-use conversion are informed by…
Lead consequential, cross-functional initiatives that deliver sustained improvements in conversion and business performance.
Shape first-use experiences that establish the foundations for long-term engagement, identifying and improving early behaviors that predict retention and continued product use.
Develop an evidence-grounded direction for your product area, identifying which opportunities warrant investment and which to exclude.
